criteria.title: Claims supported by evidence
criteria.description: Check whether conclusions follow from the sources the scout actually inspected.
criteria.pass_condition: Material claims cite relevant evidence, distinguish observations from guesses, and state missing evidence.
criteria.applicability: When the scout makes a factual claim or recommends an action.

criteria.title: Clear findings
criteria.description: Check whether a reader can understand the finding and why it matters.
criteria.pass_condition: The output identifies the issue and affected area concisely, with readable supporting detail.
criteria.applicability: When the scout produces an output intended for a person.

criteria.title: Useful next step
criteria.description: Check whether a finding gives its reader a practical way to proceed.
criteria.pass_condition: The output names a concrete next action or decision, with enough context to carry it out.
criteria.applicability: When the scout is expected to recommend action; informational updates may be not applicable.

criteria.title: Priority matches impact
criteria.description: Check whether urgency follows from demonstrated impact and scope.
criteria.pass_condition: The priority follows the stated project policy and available impact evidence without exaggerating reach.
criteria.applicability: When the scout assigns or recommends a priority.

criteria.title: Required instructions followed
criteria.description: Check whether the scout follows its assignment and required skills.
criteria.pass_condition: The trace shows required skills were consulted and task-specific constraints were respected.
criteria.applicability: When the assignment requires skills or constrains the scope of the work; missing trace evidence is unknown.

criteria.title: Relevant history considered
criteria.description: Check whether the scout uses available history to avoid duplicate or outdated findings.
criteria.pass_condition: The scout checks relevant existing memory or reports when needed and explains material changes to known issues.
criteria.applicability: When relevant history exists or the assignment requires a history check; extra writes are not required.
